scenario.summary: Threat actors are exploiting a critical authentication bypass in BeyondTrust Remote Support (CVE-2026-102764) to gain initial access and perform unauthorized file operations on vulnerable appliances. Post-exploitation, attackers execute unauthorized scripts, establish persistence through account and MFA manipulation, and move laterally using unrecognized privileged sessions while tampering with log forwarding to evade detection.

meta.rationale: Focus on self-hosted BeyondTrust/Bomgar appliances. Use software inventory to find these devices regardless of whether they have an active vulnerability finding, as the bypass is widely exploited.
meta.hypothesis: An adversary has exploited CVE-2026-102764 to bypass authentication on a BeyondTrust Remote Support appliance, resulting in unauthorized file operations and the execution of unrecognized scripts.

hunt.name: BeyondTrust Appliance Compromise and Execution
hunt.description: This hunt targets the exploitation of BeyondTrust Remote Support (formerly Bomgar) appliances. It first identifies affected appliances in the estate, then fans out to search for the outcomes of the authentication bypass: the creation of unrecognized script files and the execution of rare shells or interpreters. By combining inventory scoping with behavioral activity, the hunt identifies compromised appliances even when network-level exploitation logs are missing.

config.scoping_notes: Focus on self-hosted BeyondTrust/Bomgar appliances. Use software inventory to find these devices regardless of whether they have an active vulnerability finding, as the bypass is widely exploited.
config.beyond_detection: A simple vulnerability alert does not indicate if exploitation has occurred; this hunt correlates the presence of the software with the behavioral signals of script drops and rare shell execution to distinguish unpatched systems from active compromises.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, vendor_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%beyondtrust%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%bomgar%'
config.description: Use software inventory to find these devices regardless of whether they have an active vulnerability finding, to define the search scope.
config.expected_signal: Silence means no matching software packages are found in the inventory.

primitive_config.label: Identify BeyondTrust Remote Support appliances
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, package_name, package_version, vendor_name FROM hb_software_inventory WHERE LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%beyondtrust%' OR LOWER(package_name) LIKE '%bomgar%'
primitive_config.expected: Silence means no matching software packages are found in the inventory.

config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_path) AS shell_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, COUNT(*) AS run_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (on_disk = 0 OR (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/sh' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/bash' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/python%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/perl' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/php')) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY shell_path HAVING host_count <= 3 ORDER BY host_count ASC, run_count ASC
config.description: The query stack-counts the execution of shells and interpreters on appliances so that one-host sessions stand out from fleet-wide activity.
config.expected_signal: A shell or interpreter path seen on very few hosts. Silence suggests no unusual shell sessions occurred during the window.

primitive_config.label: Rare shell and interpreter execution
primitive_config.content: SELECT LOWER(process_path) AS shell_path, COUNT(DISTINCT device_hostname) AS host_count, COUNT(*) AS run_count, MIN(time) AS first_seen FROM hb_process_activity WHERE (on_disk = 0 OR (LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/sh' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/bash' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/python%' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/perl' OR LOWER(process_path) LIKE '%/php')) AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY shell_path HAVING host_count <= 3 ORDER BY host_count ASC, run_count ASC
primitive_config.expected: A shell or interpreter path seen on very few hosts. Silence suggests no unusual shell sessions occurred during the window.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, file_path, process_name, actor_user_name, time FROM hb_file_activity WHERE activity_id = 1 AND (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%.sh' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%.py' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%.pl' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%.php') AND (LOWER(file_path) LIKE '/tmp/%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '/var/tmp/%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '/dev/shm/%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/www/%' OR LOWER(file_path) LIKE '%/html/%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days')
config.expected_signal: Silence means no script creation was recorded.
